title: Taiwanese Association of America Colorado 科羅拉多 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America Colorado (TAA-CO, 科羅拉多 台灣同鄉會) is the Colorado chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter serves Taiwanese Americans in Colorado, with its primary base in the Denver metropolitan area.
